'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• S-R2.1 — OTIF Orchestration
  Owner: head_of_supply_chain
  Trigger: supply.otif.pct < 93.0%
  Impact: High, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 1.0–4.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · DETECT sustained OTIF deterioration for this lane-DC scope
  · DIAGNOSE the dominant OTIF loss driver for this lane-DC scope
  · ACTIVATE the corresponding execution Action Code for this lane-DC scope
  ⚠ Trigger only if service deterioration is structurally recurring
  ⚠ Do not trigger if OTIF loss is fully explained by inventory shortages

• S-R2.2 — Fulfillment & Transport Stabilisation
  Owner: logistics_manager
  Trigger: supply.on_time.pct < 94.0%
  Impact: High, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 2.0–5.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY recurring late deliveries by route and location
  · ANALYSE delay root causes by lane-DC scope
  · IMPLEMENT corrective actions for the affected route-location scope
  ⚠ Trigger only if late deliveries dominate OTIF loss
  ⚠ Do not trigger if delays are inventory-driven

• S-R2.3 — In-Full & Stockout Impact Reduction
  Owner: supply_planner
  Trigger: supply.stockout_impact.pct > 6.0%
  Impact: High, CostAvoidance
  Expected: -1.0–-4.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY SKU-lane scopes with rising in-full failures
  · REALLOCATE constrained supply by service priority for the affected SKU-lane scope
  · CORRECT partial shipment practices for the affected SKU-lane scope
  ⚠ Trigger only if in-full failures dominate OTIF loss
  ⚠ Do not trigger if issues are transport-driven

• S-R2.4 — Penalty & Expedite Cost Control
  Owner: logistics_cost_manager
  Trigger: supply.penalty.amount > 0.25%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: -10.0–-30.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY recurring penalties or expedites by lane and location
  · CLASSIFY costs as avoidable vs justified for the affected lane-DC scope
  · CORRECT underlying execution or planning issues for the affected lane-DC scope
  ⚠ Trigger only if penalties/expedites are structurally recurring
  ⚠ Do not trigger if cost increase is explained by approved service upgrades

• S-R2.5 — Planning & Execution Alignment
  Owner: s_and_op_lead
  Trigger: supply.expedite.amount > 0.25%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 1.0–3.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY regions and channels affected by repeated late forecast-version changes
  · ANALYSE root causes of plan-execution mismatch for the affected region and channel
  · ENFORCE freeze windows and escalation rules for the affected region and channel
  ⚠ Trigger only if expedites are caused by planning overrides or late changes
  ⚠ Do not trigger if expedites are driven by external disruptions'
